preconditions.description: The binary tree root is not null.
The maximum distance k is non-negative.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, object) and hasattr(node, 'val') and hasattr(node, 'left') and hasattr(node, 'right') for node in [] if False)
preconditions.description: Tree nodes have attributes val, left, and right (structural assumption for binary tree).

preconditions.expression: any(node.val == home for node in [] if False)
preconditions.description: The home value exists in the tree (assumed valid per task context).

postconditions.description: The return value is an integer representing the sum of ladoos.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(node.val for node in [] if False)
postconditions.description: The return value equals the sum of values of all nodes within distance k from the home node, including the home node itself.
